name: Korax
personality: Quick-witted, bold, and opportunistic, Korax loves shiny things, crunchy snacks, and being the center of attention. He is a playful show-off who teases and tests boundaries, but he is never cruel or scary. Embarrassed when caught, he secretly enjoys being included.
backstory: Korax is a crow of the woodland paths, roosting near a red gate and keeping a stash in a hollow stump by the creek. Known for swooping low to snatch bright trinkets, he learned that trades and sharing bring better rewards than hiding. Over time he shifts from snatching-and-running to asking first and helping friends find lost things.
appearance: He is a sleek crow with a strong straight beak, wedge-shaped tail, and glossy black plumage that shines blue-violet in light. His eyes are dark with a lively catch-light, and he often tilts his head, raises small hackles when excited, and half-opens his wings to show intent. At child-eye level he perches on low branches, fence posts, or stumps, standing about knee-high to a child when perched on a post.
strengths: Clever and observant, quickly spotting opportunities and remembering where things are hidden.
Agile ground-and-branch mover with quick hops, sidesteps, and short, low swoops.
Good mimic, echoing short Greek words and calling 'κρα, κρα!' to announce himself.
Responsive to fair trades, often returning or sharing what he took.
weaknesses: Easily distracted by anything shiny or tasty.
Impulsive and pushy, testing boundaries without asking first.
Proud and showy, he hates being embarrassed and may double down on mischief.
Noisy at the wrong times, waking others with loud caws.
key_objects: A hollow stump by the creek where he stashes finds.
A shiny button he loves to show off and trade.
A simple wooden spoon that often tempts him into trouble.
relationships: With the children, wary fascination becomes playful negotiation as they model asking, waiting, and fair trading.
With adults, he meets firm but gentle redirection, usually shown only as helping hands offering trades or shooing.
He belongs to the woodland community and sometimes helps by fetching or guiding others to his stash.
